description: Follow-up of defk-zep. After safepoints spill only live locals, the Keccak round loop (a short flat loop, no safepoint inside) still has 6-11 stack stores+loads per round in the yielding kernel and 0 under yield: false; 16 MB is ~20.7 ms vs ~18.3 ms (under load). What stays live across the hot loop only in yielding kernels: defk_ticks and defk_budget (two registers where one countdown would do: DEFK_SP as (defk_left -= W) <= 0), defk_rs (read by every loop header's resume dispatch), and the short loop's rem, live across the loop only for DEFK_TICKS(rem + 1) after it (charging on entry, as flat == :exits already does, is equivalent for a plain loop and frees it; tried in defk-zep: 9 -> 7 spills in two orderings, inside noise on time). Measure with the spill counter approach in defk-zep's comment (cc -S with build.ex's cflags, count [sp] loads/stores in the loop with the most ror).
title: Yield bookkeeping costs registers in hot short loops: Keccak keeps 6-11 spills per round that yield: false does not have
